label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

findings.problem: [name] banner sits at the end of the keyboard order after skip-less page start; focus began on a link inside the banner text and I had to Tab past [name] Policy and Privacy Policy links and Preferences before reaching Decline
A location popup (change to another country site) appeared after cookies and focus landed on the popup container, then an unnamed close icon button; it was confusing which control dismissed it

No skip to main content link: after the page loads, reaching the first product needed about 40 Tab presses through the header, search, account, cart, country, two separate menu bars and footer-like links
Main menu items are duplicated as an unnamed div, a link and later again as buttons and links, so each menu entry takes two or more Tab stops and some stops have no name
Several controls have no accessible name: an icon button in the header, an empty link and an icon button before the products, and a product tile link with no text, so I could not tell what they do
Opening a product reloaded the whole page with focus reset to the top, so the long header must be tabbed through again before reaching size options and Add to cart; I ran out of steps
